name: Nadaraya-Watson Envelope (NWE)
author: third-party
description: Kernel regression envelope using the Nadaraya-Watson estimator. Plots a smooth price estimate (midline) with three boundary levels above and below. Price at the Far boundary signals overextension; price returning toward the midline signals mean reversion.

outputs.name: Upper Boundary: Far
outputs.description: Furthest upper band — strong overextension to the upside

outputs.name: Nadaraya-Watson Estimation
outputs.description: Midline / equilibrium — kernel regression of price

outputs.name: Lower Boundary: Near
outputs.description: Closest lower band — mild overextension to downside

outputs.name: Lower Boundary: Far
outputs.description: Furthest lower band — strong overextension to the downside

reading_guide.ici_usage: In ICI Confluence, 'NWE band' refers to price touching the Average or Far boundary during the correction. Near boundary alone is not sufficient for Tier 1 entry.
reading_guide.midline: Nadaraya-Watson Estimation = equilibrium. Price gravitates back toward this after overextension.
reading_guide.tier1_entry: Price at Average or Far boundary + inside FVG + touching TPO POC = Tier 1 entry signal

inputs.note: Verify settings on chart. Common inputs: bandwidth (h), multiplier for boundary distances
